title: Local retractions of the transpose of an epimorphism onto a vector bundle
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $P,Q$ be $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and assume $Q$ is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Let $f:P\to Q$ be an epimorphism. The transpose $f^\vee:\mathcal Hom(Q,\mathcal O_X)\to\mathcal Hom(P,\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] locally admits a retraction: for each point $x\in X$ there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ such that $f^\vee|_U$ has a left inverse [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. No quasi-coherence or finiteness of $P$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0EKP, proof of (2) to (3), taking the dual of the surjection; local-splitting details expanded from the finite-basis argument. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EKP.

proof.text: Fix x and trivialize Q on an open W containing x with a finite basis. For each basis section use local surjectivity of the sheaf epimorphism f to obtain a lift on a neighbourhood V_i of x contained in W. Their finite intersection U is open and contains x. Restrict the lifts to U and use the universal property of the finite free sheaf to define s:Q|_U -> P|_U. Since f composed with s fixes every basis section, s followed by f|_U is the identity. In rank zero take U=W and the unique map out of zero.

Internal Hom commutes with open restriction: sections over V contained in U are module morphisms over V, so restriction merely restricts that morphism. Under this identification the restriction of dualMap f sends phi to phi composed with f|_V. Precomposition with s restricts compatibly on all smaller V and gives a retraction, since s followed by f is the identity. Transport this retraction from the over category to scheme restriction. For the empty scheme the quantified claim has no points.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_retraction_dualMap_of_epi
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {P Q : X.Modules} (f : P ⟶ Q) [Epi f] [Q.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      IsSplitMono ((restrictFunctor U.ι).map (dualMap f))
